intro: If you're planning to explore the U-Thong–Don Chedi side of the province and want a small, quiet, clean place at a budget-friendly price — Petchngam Home Resort is one many travellers reach for. It's a small home resort of around 18 rooms in U-Thong District, laid out as detached air-con rooms in a garden, with spacious ~28 sqm rooms that include a fridge and kettle. It sits just ~2km from U-Thong market and the Banharn–Jaemsai Clock Tower, with U-Thong National Museum and the ancient U-Thong sites a short drive on. Rates start at around ฿750/night — the trade-offs being that it's a small stay with no pool and no breakfast, set around 25km from Suphan Buri city centre.

body.html: What earns Petchngam Home Resort its strong scores among U-Thong stays is cleanliness and quiet. Real guest reviews on booking platforms talk about tidy, well-kept rooms and calm surroundings — a place for proper rest, not a busy roadside stop. The resort is a small property of around 18 rooms, with detached air-con rooms set in a garden, so it feels more like a garden home than a hotel.

Rooms are standard king-size, around 28 square metres, which is generously sized for the price. Each comes with air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a refrigerator, an electric kettle and bathroom toiletries. Many reviews rate the rooms and amenities highly, since you get a spacious, clean room with a comfortable bed at an accessible rate. It suits couples, small families, or travellers stopping in U-Thong for a night.
"Spacious, very clean and quiet, the owner looks after the place well, parking is easy and the price is fair for what you get. A good pick if you're staying around U-Thong."

On location, Petchngam Home Resort sits in U-Thong District, about 2km from U-Thong market and the Banharn–Jaemsai Clock Tower. A short drive on takes you to U-Thong National Museum (~2.5km), which tells the story of the ancient Dvaravati-era city of U-Thong. This side also works well as a base for Don Chedi, the Don Chedi Monument and the temples around U-Thong. It suits travellers focused on the history and culture of the U-Thong side rather than central Suphan Buri.

To be straight with you, this is a small home resort with simple facilities — no swimming pool and no breakfast. There's free Wi-Fi, free parking, a garden and outdoor seating, but not full-service hotel amenities. If you want a pool for the kids or breakfast served on site, this may not be the place. The appeal here is clean, spacious, quiet rooms at an affordable rate — not a long list of resort facilities.

One more thing to factor in is the distance from Suphan Buri town, around 25km away. If your main plan is the city centre, Samchuk Centenary Market or the Dragon Descendants Museum in town, staying in U-Thong means building in drive time each way. You'll really want your own car, as public transport in the area is limited. But if your trip is already aimed at the U-Thong–Don Chedi side, this location is convenient and cuts the commute.

Overall, Petchngam Home Resort scores around 8.8 out of 10 from real guest reviews on booking platforms (review numbers are still modest, as it's a small property). It's a neat fit for travellers exploring the U-Thong side who want a spacious, clean, quiet room at a budget-friendly price and are fine without a pool or breakfast. Rates start around ฿750 for a standard room on weekdays, rising a little on weekends. Measured on cleanliness and room size at this price, this kind of stay isn't easy to find around U-Thong — it's good value.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Petchngam Home Resort Suphan Buri

faq.q: Where is Petchngam Home Resort in Suphan Buri, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Petchngam Home Resort is at 691 Moo 3, U-Thong, Suphan Buri. It's about 2km from U-Thong market and the Banharn–Jaemsai Clock Tower, and around 2.5km from U-Thong National Museum. It makes a handy base for the U-Thong–Don Chedi side, and sits about 25km from Suphan Buri city centre.

faq.q: How much does Petchngam Home Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿750/night for a standard king room on weekdays. Rooms are standard, around 28 sqm, with air-con, a TV, a fridge and a kettle. Prices rise a little on weekends, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Petchngam Home Resort have a pool or breakfast?
faq.a: No to both — Petchngam Home Resort is a small home resort with no swimming pool and no breakfast service. There's free Wi-Fi, free parking, a garden and outdoor seating. The strength here is spacious, clean, quiet rooms at an accessible price.

faq.q: Who is Petchngam Home Resort best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for couples, small families or travellers exploring the U-Thong–Don Chedi side who want a spacious, clean, quiet room at a budget-friendly price. Because it's a small property with simple facilities and sits outside town, it's less suited to those wanting a pool, breakfast or a city-centre base.

faq.q: Do I need my own car to get to Petchngam Home Resort?
faq.a: You really should have your own car. The resort is in U-Thong, where public transport is limited and there aren't many restaurants nearby. Driving yourself makes it easy to reach Don Chedi and the temples around U-Thong, and the resort has free parking.

faq.q: How big are the rooms at Petchngam Home Resort?
faq.a: Standard rooms are around 28 square metres with a king-size bed, which is generously sized for the price. Each has air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, an electric kettle and bathroom toiletries — one reason reviews rate the rooms and cleanliness so highly.
